notes.title: The End of Skyflower
notes.content:
Hi everyone. It's been three years since Skyflower's release! I built this game as a freshman in high school -- and there were definitely many things that I could have done better. Number one on this list is continuity. Many improvements were never developed in time, and at this point, Skyflower has (regrettably) joined the long list of unfinished early access games.

For me, Skyflower was an incredible learning experience. It's my first game that I've ever brought to release. As I start my next projects, I've got an idea where the roadbumps will be, and I've got plans to handle them. First things first: no Early Access! I'm only putting out finished games, and if you'll stick with me, I hope you enjoy them!

Check out RAIN Project: rain-project-game.com

notes.title: Skyflower has been released!
notes.content: Fight your way to the top in this action-packed permanent death dungeon crawler! Challenge minibosses, complete puzzles, and shoot everything on your path to the skies.
